svg.text: ImpactIQ — AI Agents, Gemini & Result Analysis
Google ADK 1.11 multi-agent investigation · Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-lite · RAG with gemini-embedding-001 · deterministic scoring + AI review
Admin uploads project documents → async documentExecutor → searchable knowledge for every agent and the chatbot
B · AI defect investigation — 6 stages, run strictly in sequence (InvestigationOrchestrator)
Triggered from Defect detail → InvestigationService queues the run (2 worker threads, 1 active run per defect, max 4 active) → each stage saved as an InvestigationStep
Model layer — every LLM call goes through the same path
Errors retried per call: RATE_LIMITED, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, MODEL_TIMEOUT, INVALID_OUTPUT
MISSING_API_KEY / AUTH_FAILED / RUN_TIMEOUT → remaining model stages skipped
Non-critical stage fails → run continues → PARTIAL
Root cause fails → FAILED (no hypotheses to fix)
Re-run allowed for FAILED / PARTIAL, up to 3 attempts per defect
Stage output reused from the parent run when fingerprint matches
No live Gemini in tests: scripted model clients + H2
C · How the impact result is analysed
Deterministic baseline first, AI only suggests — both stored side by side
Gets defect fields + baseline + breakdown → returns impactScore, risk,
priority, confidence, summary, explanation, actions, affected areas
Server checks score ↔ risk ↔ priority use the same bands
Saved in impact_analyses next to baseline — never overrides it
Grounded Q&A on projects, defects, investigations and knowledge
redacted + injection-checked; 10 replies / user / min, 4 concurrent
D1 attached defect · I# latest investigation hypotheses
ADK LlmAgent, JSON schema, 90 s timeout
Conversations kept 90 days · stale PENDING replies marked as errors on restart
E · AI defect drafts & dashboard insights
Helps users write defects and tracks AI quality
LLM · NOT SAVED UNTIL USER SUBMITS
Modes: QUICK text · PASTE logs · UPLOAD file (validated + extracted)
→ title, description, environment, service, function, users,
4 impact signals, category, missing info, rationale
Gemini error → HEURISTIC draft (first error-like line as title)
Runs: total · active · COMPLETED · PARTIAL · FAILED
Open HIGH / CRITICAL defects · recent / failed / high-risk lists
Each list shows hypothesis count + top hypothesis title
only real D# / E# / K# / I# IDs
admin / reporter only; RAG per project
indexed chunks → K# for stage 1 + chatbot
